planets.name: HD 224018 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 224018 with a 36.6-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: HD 224018 c was found in 2025 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 224018. Its orbit and size follow Damasso et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
